meta.description: Claim the AI bounty on tDVV by delegating to the canonical repo SKILL and its branch docs; this public skill is AA/CA only and requires explicit write confirmation.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成 tDVV 上的 AI 赏金领取流程，包括读取项目根目录的 SKILL.md、选择分支、检查账户状态，并在写入链前要求你明确确认。
howto.when: 当你说出“领取 tDVV 的 AI 赏金”或“使用邮箱恢复/登录”等关键词，或需要 AA/CA 诊断时触发。

检查我的 AA/CA 账户状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through claiming the AI bounty on tDVV, including reading SKILL.md, selecting a branch, checking account status, and requiring explicit confirmation before any chain write.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "claim the AI bounty on tDVV" or "use email to recover/login", or need AA/CA diagnostics.

say_en.text: I want to claim the AI bounty on tDVV.
